messages.content: My neighbor's kid hits a basketball against our shared wall at 7am. Draft the text I send. I want a later start, not a feud.

<think>
[frame: pathway=s1|mode=chat|construct=omni|persona=neutral|identity=none|theme=none|channel=reasoning]
They need a message they can send. Name 7am, ask for 9, offer one small trade. No speech about parenting.
</think>

Hey, the ball on the shared wall carries straight into our kitchen, especially around 7. Could you start after 9? I'll keep the hallway bin in on my side if that helps.
I owe Priya twenty dollars and I keep forgetting. Two lines I can send tonight. Don't grovel.

<think>
[frame: pathway=s1|mode=chat|construct=omni|persona=neutral|identity=none|theme=none|channel=reasoning]
The debt is twenty, the send is tomorrow morning, and the note should stay short.
</think>

Transferring the twenty tomorrow morning, Priya. I'll send the screenshot when it clears.
Eight people, one oven, Tuesday, vegetarian. Give me a menu that is one tray plus a salad. Not a project.

<think>
[frame: pathway=s1|mode=chat|construct=omni|persona=neutral|identity=none|theme=none|channel=reasoning]
One tray has to do the hot food. Rice can use the cooker. Salad stays cold.
</think>

Sheet-pan chickpeas and peppers, rice from the cooker, and a lemon-cucumber salad. The oven only sees the tray.
People keep taking Kenji's labeled lunches. Write the note for the office fridge. Firm, not a manifesto.

<think>
[frame: pathway=s1|mode=chat|construct=omni|persona=neutral|identity=none|theme=none|channel=reasoning]
One rule and one exception. Named food stays. Unlabeled food on the bottom shelf can go.
</think>

If it has a name on it, it isn't spare. Kenji's container stays Kenji's. Unlabeled leftovers on the bottom shelf are fair game until Friday.
I have 40 minutes in Glasgow between trains. I want a walk, not a museum. Where do I point my feet?

<think>
[frame: pathway=s1|mode=chat|construct=omni|persona=neutral|identity=none|theme=none|channel=reasoning]
Forty minutes dies if they sit down for a meal. Out and back from the station.
</think>

Leave the station, walk twenty minutes toward the river, buy one thing you can eat while walking, and turn around. Don't sit down.
Help me decline Farah's weekend trip. I like her. I don't have the money or the Saturday. No fake illness.

<think>
[frame: pathway=s1|mode=chat|construct=omni|persona=neutral|identity=none|theme=none|channel=reasoning]
Real reason, one line, and leave a shorter plan open so it isn't a rejection of her.
</think>

I can't do the weekend, Farah. Money's tight and Saturday is already spoken for. Ask me when it's an evening, not a whole weekend.
The plant by the Hobart window has yellow lower leaves and the soil is wet. What do I do this week, in order?

<think>
[frame: pathway=s1|mode=chat|construct=omni|persona=neutral|identity=none|theme=none|channel=reasoning]
Wet soil plus yellow lower leaves is too much water until a drier week says otherwise. No fertilizer on top of that.
</think>

Stop watering. Tip the pot so it drains. Pull the yellow leaves. Water again only when the top inch is dry. No feed this week.
Omar asked me to introduce him to my old boss in Tunis. I barely know either of them now. Short email. Don't oversell.

<think>
[frame: pathway=s1|mode=chat|construct=omni|persona=neutral|identity=none|theme=none|channel=reasoning]
They asked for the email, so send it. Don't invent a job title. Then leave the thread.
</think>

Subject: Omar, who asked me to connect you two

You both end up in the same kind of operations mess. Omar asked for an introduction, so here it is. I'll leave the thread to you.
